unasserted.why: no version was read (pre-init result, no init): C2 §5 and the vendor spec do not decide whether TurnEnd.instance is null or {vendor_version: null, version_status: untested} for a pre-handshake failure; reported to the coordinator

expect.notes: The replay pins the literal --resume value, sessions.main.resume, so a driver that passes another ID fails the replay. --resume of a missing session gives a pre-init result (error_during_execution, num_turns 0, errors 'No conversation found ...') that echoes the requested UUID. A pre-init rejection never confirms identity or opens (C2 §2 delayed identity); the definite, fixture-backed missing-session rejection is StartRejected::SessionGone and the same VIA session is kept (packet §2). No init was read, so vendor_version is null (C2 §5). The rejection carries TurnEvidence (C2 §2 AdapterError::Rejected): the launched process exited, so cleanup is quiescent on Host's group cleanup evidence.
